name: Applied Physics I
topics: Interference in Thin Films
Derive the conditions for intensity maxima and minima for interference of light reflected from a thin film.
Find the least thickness of a soap film of given refractive index that appears bright and dark by reflection.
Diffraction: N-Slit and Grating
Derive the intensity distribution for diffraction through N slits and the conditions for maxima and minima.
A grating with 15,000 lines per inch is used with the mercury green line; find the angular separation between first and second orders.
Polarisation
Unpolarised light passes through two polarising sheets. Find the angle between their axes for the given transmitted intensities.
Oscillations: SHM, Damped and Forced
Solve the differential equation of a damped harmonic oscillator driven by a sinusoidal force and discuss resonance.
A particle in SHM has the given velocities at two positions; find its amplitude and period.
Central Forces and Two-Body Problem
For a central force, show that angular momentum and areal velocity are constant.
Reduce the two-body problem to an equivalent one-body problem and define reduced mass.
Quantum Mechanics: de Broglie Waves and Particle in a Box
Explain group and phase velocity of a wave packet and show that de Broglie waves travel with the particle velocity; compute the de Broglie wavelength of a 10 eV electron.
Solve the time-independent Schrödinger equation for a particle in a 1-D box and draw ψₙ and |ψₙ|² for n = 1, 2, 3.
Lasers and Optical Fibres
Differentiate spontaneous and stimulated emission and derive Einstein's A and B coefficients.
Calculate the numerical aperture and acceptance angle of the given step-index fibre; explain an optical-fibre communication channel.
